query: ALTER TABLE public.packages ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS category varchar(40) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'marketing'; ALTER TABLE public.packages ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS price_one_time_sar integer NULL; ALTER TABLE public.packages ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS compare_at_price_sar integer NULL; ALTER TABLE public.packages ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS cta_label_ar varchar(120) NULL; ALTER TABLE public.packages ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS cta_label_en varchar(120) NULL; ALTER TABLE public.packages ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS metadata jsonb NULL; CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS packages_category_published_order_idx ON public.packages (category, is_published, sort_order); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.package_addons (id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, slug varchar(80) NOT NULL UNIQUE, category varchar(40) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'technology', name_ar varchar(120) NOT NULL, name_en varchar(120) NOT NULL, subtitle_ar varchar(255) NULL, subtitle_en varchar(255) NULL, price_sar integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, billing_cycle varchar(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'one_time', tag_ar varchar(80) NULL, tag_en varchar(80) NULL, features_ar jsonb NULL, features_en jsonb NULL, metadata jsonb NULL, sort_order integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, is_featured boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, is_published boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, created_at timestamp(0) without time zone NULL, updated_at timestamp(0) without time zone NULL); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS package_addons_category_published_order_idx ON public.package_addons (category, is_published, sort_order); ALTER TABLE public.portfolio_projects ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS metric_ar varchar(255) NULL; ALTER TABLE public.portfolio_projects ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS metric_en varchar(255) NULL; ALTER TABLE public.portfolio_projects ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS outcome_ar varchar(255) NULL; ALTER TABLE public.portfolio_projects ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS outcome_en varchar(255) NULL; ALTER TABLE public.portfolio_projects ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS evidence_note_ar text NULL; ALTER TABLE public.portfolio_projects ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS evidence_note_en text NULL; ALTER TABLE public.portfolio_projects ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS period_ar varchar(120) NULL; ALTER TABLE public.portfolio_projects ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS period_en varchar(120) NULL; ALTER TABLE public.portfolio_projects ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS gallery jsonb NULL; ALTER TABLE public.portfolio_projects ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS metadata jsonb NULL; ALTER TABLE public.package_addons ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE public.packages ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE public.portfolio_projects ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
